name: FUN_DS_DATA_ROLES_UPG_AUDIT
description: This table contains information about the decomposition of generated data roles, their corresponding source data role templates and data security contexts. It is a persistent table.

columns.name: DATA_ROLE_UPG_ID
columns.description: Record identifier for data role upgrade audit entity.

columns.name: DATA_ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of data role generated by a data role template.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Record identifier for data role template.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_FULL_PATH
columns.description: Full directory path for the data role template file from which this data role is generated.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the product that owns the data role.

columns.name: BASE_ROLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the base role upon which this data role is based.

columns.name: DIMENSION_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Database object corresponding to the security dimension value of the data role.

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the data role is generated from the seeded or custom content.

columns.name: PK_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Primary key column name for the security dimension database object.

columns.name: PK_VALUE
columns.description: Security dimension value correspoding to the data role.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates progress of the data role upgrade.

columns.name: PROCESS_DATE
columns.description: Date when the data role upgrade is run.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Errors encountered during data role upgrade.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
